# cleanser

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of cleanser is to gather a Set of Utility Functions to Check, Clean and Prepare a dataset

## Installation

This package is not available on CRAN, to install it please use the following commands:

From GitHub:

``` r
remotes::install_github("AcidyBee/cleanser")
```


## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

```{r example}
library(cleanser)
## basic example code
```

Computes a composite score on 2 columns:

```{r cars}
expand.grid(
  g = c(NA_real_, 0, NA_real_),
  ptc = c(NA_real_, 0, 1)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(is_na_score = compute_composite_score(g, ptc, na.rm = TRUE),
    score_fun = "rowSums") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(g, ptc)
```
